title: Resume
text:
ENVIRONMENTAL SECTOR EXPERIENCE
Graduate Research Assistant; Virginia Commonwealth University | uLESA Team & Jones Lab
September 2025 - Present
Using ArcGIS Pro, developed an adapted Land Evaluation and Site Assessment (LESA) analysis for urban agriculture suitability in partnership with the City of Dayton, Ohio. Coordinated with local governmental and community stakeholders to assess over 20 unique pollution and land evaluation factors in a comprehensive geospatial model. Served as teaching assistant for an undergraduate applied GIS course.
Presented findings at the annual VAMLIS (Virginia Association for Mapping and Land Information Systems) conference in October 2026.
GIS Technician; Virginia Department of Environmental Quality | Richmond Central Office
May 2026 - September 2026 (Seasonal)
Led the implementation of a major data overhaul of all Virginia riverine spatial data units as part of the Water Quality Assessment team. Created best practices documentation and live ArcGIS tutorials for future project iterations, coordinated with regional DEQ office assessors to ensure data alignment with regional surface water assessment and monitoring team needs, and wrote quality assurance and progress tracking scripts using Python and R.
Scientific Programs Intern; Foundation for Food & Agriculture Research (FFAR) | Remote
May 2026 - December 2026
As part of FFAR’s Scientific Workforce Development priority area, worked with the program director to address challenges in recruitment and retention across the agriculture sciences industry and academic workforce. Developed presentation materials for workforce strategy project proposals in alignment with USDA priorities and created novel interactive spatial data tools to better visualize the geographic distribution of workforce program grant investment.
Research Assistant; University of Virginia | Anthropology and Environmental Science Departments
September 2015-April 2017
Conducted fieldwork with the Center for the Development of Cambodian Agriculture (CEDAC) on the emergence and spread of novel organic produce farming and land management practices in rural Cambodia. Awarded Jefferson Public Citizens Award for Undergraduate Research.
Contributed to ecological and hydrological research on Morven Research Farm. Assessed nitrogen flows and biochar fertilizer implementation on Timber Creek permaculture farm in collaboration with agriculturalists.
